name: Fish Assad Curry
instructions: 1. Marinate fish with turmeric and salt. 2. Sauté onions, ginger-garlic paste, and green chilies. 3. Add aniseed and coconut milk. 4. Gently simmer the fish in the gravy until cooked. 5. Finish with a squeeze of lime.
description: A delicate French-Creole fusion, where the mildness of coconut milk meets the zing of local spices.
